pieces.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: clean product presentation background for video editing and thumbnails. Scene: one empty cylindrical plaster pedestal in a seamless warm off-white studio, no product. Style: premium photorealistic studio photography. Composition: 16:9 landscape, 50mm lens, slightly elevated frontal view, pedestal centered low with generous clean space around it. Lighting: one large softbox from the upper left and weak bounce from the right, neutral 5000K, controlled soft shadow. Materials: fine matte plaster with subtle handmade texture. Constraints: empty pedestal, no people, no hands, no faces, no products, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no brands, no watermark.
